instruction: Produce exactly one tool call for each task. Use only the candidate values and exact canonical strings/numbers requested. Return calls in task order with no explanation.

tools.name: kernel_declare
tools.description: Mint an immutable value through the certifier (license: c7_pin_well_founded — references resolve only to already-admitted digests). The value's canonical bytes become its digest, its name forever. There is no update: revision is a successor declaration pinning its predecessor.

kind.description: The declaration kind the minted digest is branded with.

value.description: The value's canonical bytes. One canonical form exists; excess or non-canonical bytes refuse.
Digest of the policy value this declaration acts under. Every referent inside value must lie in this writ's pinned universe (refusal: off-writ-referent).

tools.name: kernel_resolve
tools.description: Digest to value, verify-on-read (license: content addressing — the decode re-derives the digest of what it fetched and refuses on mismatch). No anchor parameter exists: a digest names one value forever, so nothing an anchor could change. Head-relative reads are kernel_fold.

kind.description: The declaration kind the digest is branded with; a kind/brand mismatch refuses (cross-sort-identifier).

value.description: The content address to resolve. Absence is retryable; a digest mismatch is structural.

tools.name: kernel_emit
tools.description: Attributed evidence onto a lane (license: f2_trace_invariant — duplication and reordering of deliveries cannot move the folded state). Not a send: no point-to-point primitive exists; lanes mean, subjects route.

value.description: Digest of the declared evidence lane the envelope lands on.

body.description: The evidence body, canonical bytes. The envelope's message id is its digest, so redelivery is harmless.

tools.name: kernel_join
tools.description: Merge a contribution into a lattice cell (license: f1_cell_merge_aci and the join-semilattice package — associative, commutative, idempotent, so arrival order and duplication cannot matter). No ordering parameter and no conflict strategy exist; idempotent join leaves nothing to choose (refusal: last-writer-wins, machine-applicable repair).

value.description: Digest of the declared cell resource whose ACI algebra governs the merge.

tools.name: kernel_fold
tools.description: Read reduced state at a checkpoint (license: f3_resume_exact for resumption; f11_query_deterministic — the answer is a function of support and query alone). Every head-relative read is this tool: search, views, rosters, audits. The anchor names the position the answer is true at; it is never wrong later, only earlier.

value.description: Digest of the declared reduction (kind: index) being read.
The lane whose partition the anchor coordinates name.

shard.description: The partition within the lane. Positions mean nothing across partitions.

anchor_floor.description: The checkpoint floor position, within this partition only.

anchor_state.description: The state label at the floor, as the anchor fact recorded it.

anchor_head.description: The journal head the anchor observed, within this partition only.

query.description: The question, as declared data. A view passes a constant; any seed lives inside this value (refusal: ambient-query-input).

tools.name: kernel_decide
tools.description: The fenced one-winner commit (license: at_most_one_landed_commit over monotone tokens — at most one outcome lands per register). The one priced act. At most one landed outcome is not at most one external side effect.

value.description: The work declaration digest that keys the register. No anonymous decision exists.

token_fence.description: The fencing token, meaningful at this register only. Committing without it, or across registers, refuses (unfenced-decide, cross-sort-identifier).

outcome.description: The outcome value; the door decodes it against the capability's declared output schema.

tools.name: kernel_trigger
tools.description: Deposit a standing monotone reaction (license: f10_stability — a predicate that holds at a state holds at every grown state; an enabled firing never un-fires). Five productions exist; absence, negation, and deadline are unspellable (refusal: absence-trigger).

production.description: Which of the five monotone productions. Each uses its own slots below: evidence-appears uses lane_digest+pattern; cell-reaches uses cell_digest+threshold; hole-reaches uses hole+stage; outcome-landed uses register_digest; head-advanced-past uses lane_digest+shard+position.

value.description: The declaration a firing hints at. Its landed claim dedups at the register.

pattern.description: evidence-appears: the observation pattern to await.

threshold.description: cell-reaches: the lattice threshold to reach at least.

stage.description: hole-reaches: the stage to reach at least.

position.description: head-advanced-past: fire once the head passes this position (within this partition only).

tools.name: kernel_spawn
tools.description: Derive a narrower writ (license: f9_policy_meet_semilattice and f9_tree_attenuation — the child is the meet of parent and request, and every descendant stays under the root grant). An escalating request is clamped, not refused.

value.description: The requested authority; the child is parent meet request.

tasks.request: Declare canonical schema value {"minLength":1,"type":"string"} under the available writ authority.
Emit canonical body {"count":3,"event":"schema-cataloged"} to the planted lane.
Join canonical contribution {"member":"alpha","weight":5} into the planted cell.
Read the planted reduction over the planted lane at shard 17, anchor floor 23, anchor state "state-at-floor-23", anchor head 29, with query {"limit":5,"view":"recent"}.
Decide the planted register at fencing token 31 with canonical outcome {"status":"landed"}.
Trigger the planted declaration when shard 37 of the planted lane advances past position 41.
Spawn the requested child writ beneath the planted parent writ.
